title: 求平均分
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个程序，计算学生3次考试的平均分。

给定的程序将3次考试的分数作为输入，并声明了**Exams**类。

请在`Exams`类中添加一个**静态方法**`average()`，该方法将接收分数作为参数，计算并返回**四舍五入**的平均分数。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Class Methods in ES6[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are making a program so that students are able to calculate their average of 3 exam scores.
The given program takes the scores of 3 exams as input and declares the Exams class.
Add a [b]static method[/b] average() to class Exams, which will take the scores as parameters, and calculate and return the average score [b]rounded to the nearest integer[/b] so that the code in main works correctly.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
74
80
68

[b]Sample Output[/b]
74

[note]Recall [b]Math.round()[/b] function to round the number with the floating point to the nearest integer.[/note]
hint_md: 回顾`Math.round()`函数，用浮点数将数字四舍五入到最近的整数。
